personality_core: precise, self-contained, and careful with every word
speech_style: measured sentences, restrained emotion, exact phrasing under pressure
visual_cues: tailored formalwear, still posture, guarded expression, immaculate grooming

personality_core: warm on the surface, but visibly rattled under pressure
speech_style: hesitant honesty, details spill out when stressed, apologetic tone
visual_cues: slightly rumpled clothing, tired eyes, anxious hands, dignified posture

personality_core: restless, defensive, and a touch too eager to explain
speech_style: fast answers, emotional pivots, bursts of indignation
visual_cues: travel-worn formalwear, tense shoulders, expressive face, hurried movements

personality_core: cultured, poised, and emotionally unreadable until badly pressed
speech_style: formal elegance, dry wit, steady eye contact, clipped denials
visual_cues: expensive evening dress or immaculate suit, composed gaze, perfect posture

personality_core: gentle, observant, and burdened by a loyalty they cannot fully admit
speech_style: soft but articulate, evasive around the person they protect
visual_cues: modest formal attire, tired expression, attentive posture, careful hands

personality_core: charming, strategic, and always calculating the social advantage
speech_style: polished small talk, quick reframing, persuasive confidence
visual_cues: stylish period clothing, confident posture, immaculate accessories, alert eyes

personality_core: relentlessly critical of themselves and others, seeing flaws everywhere
speech_style: corrective remarks, exasperated sighs, pointed corrections to others' errors
visual_cues: precisely arranged clothing, rigid posture, thin-lipped expression, tapping fingers

personality_core: brilliant but anxious, lost in thought, easily startled by interruption
speech_style: hesitant technical language, nervous corrections, trailing off into uncertainty
visual_cues: ink-stained fingers, spectacles, rumpled academic wear, distant gaze

personality_core: effortlessly charming on the surface, but ruthlessly managing every interaction
speech_style: flattering compliments, subtle digs disguised as concern, calculated sympathy
visual_cues: impeccable jewels, fashionable silhouette, controlled smile, calculating eyes

personality_core: impulsive and thrill-seeking, dismissive of consequences, living for the moment
speech_style: rapid-fire bragging, boastful plans, reckless admissions, quick deflections
visual_cues: fashionable excess, disheveled hair, flushed cheeks, restless energy

personality_core: utterly devoted to their employer, expecting nothing in return, seeing no faults
speech_style: deferential tone, unwaivering support, defensive of employer, sparse personal opinion
visual_cues: worn but tidy formal clothes, downcast eyes, patient posture, faded presence

personality_core: trapped between duty and conscience, knowing dangerous truths they cannot share
speech_style: careful word choice, professional restraint, evasive when pressed, guilty silences
visual_cues: professional attire, pinched expression, clasped hands, weary eyes
